Name: Mad scientist
Dialog: You know what we're going to do today, Torbo? It's time to test...the teleport! (Flips a switch, causing the teleports to activate. Torbo teleports to the one to the right, only get to singed.) Eureka! Now I can teleport myself anywhere in the world!

Name: Torbo
Dialog: Wouldn't you have to take one of those teleport things there first? Oh, but then you'd already be there.

Name: Torbo
Dialog: (continued) It kinda renders the whole thing redundant, doesn't it?

Name: Mad scientist
Dialog: Do you want me to remove your tongue again, Torbo?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! (turns off TV with the remote) I know what we can do today, Ferb. (chuckles while Ferb covers his mouth with his hands) No, not the tongue thing. The teleporter.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (off screen) Hey, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. Ferb and I are gonna build a teleport device.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, great. I wish you could teleport to where my earrings are. I've lost them.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The dangly smoky topaz or the hoops?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hoops.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, she must be wearing the blue dress. We'll keep an eye out for 'em. (To Ferb) Come on, Ferb. We're burnin' daylight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Teleports completed! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sniffs) (record scratch) Ew! (Perry wakes up) You're not supposed to be here. (Perry chatters) I told Phineas and Ferb to keep you outta my room. (kicks the bedroom door open as she's holding Perry) I'm gonna give them a piece of my mind.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Do you know where Phineas and Ferb are?

Name: Linda
Dialog: They're in the garage, honey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, by the way, Jeremy's gonna be here soon. Please try not to embarrass me in front of him again.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What do you mean, again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Remember my fifth-grade graduation with the inflatable–

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, that's right. My bad.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is a glorious day for mankind. Ready with the camera so we can document it? (Ferb gets ready with the camera) Cheese!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace runs in front of the lens right when Ferb takes the photo.) How many times have I told you to keep Perry out of my room?! (notices the teleports) What are those?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Teleports. Pretty cool, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so bus – Aah! (trips on a controller, disappears through one teleport, and appears from the other)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool, it worked. (suddenly looks concerned) Candace? Are you OK?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pointing at her brothers) Wait a second. How did you guys get so big? (gasps) And why is my hand green?

Name: {Editor's Note
Dialog: Until Perry and Candace switch back, this transcript refers Perry in Candace's body as Perry/Candace and Candace in Perry's body as Candace/Perry.}

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (takes a pink mirror from a nearby box; screaming) I'm an ugly, smelly platypus!!! I'm a platypus! I'm a platypus! I'm a platypus! I'm a platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (talking over) Amazing. You and Perry going through the teleport at the same time must have switched your brains!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Oh, you think? You guys better change me back now or I'll... Wait... Jeremy's gonna be here soon!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not a problem, sis. We'll just put you both through the teleporter again. Hey, where's Perry? Uh, I-I mean Candace. I mean Perry in Candace's body?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder where he scampered off to. Any ideas, Ferb?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. We built a teleportation device and accidentally switched Candace and Perry's brains.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really? That's so cool!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: You wouldn't think it was so cool if you smelled like this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're looking for Perry so we can switch them back to normal. Wanna help?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You betcha.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (off screen) Carl! How many times have I told you, lift the seat when you're done?! (Monogram rises on his seat.)

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) Sorry!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, there you... Uh-oh. Carl, I think we have a breach of security.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) What do you mean, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There's a teenage girl in here.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (pushes forward) A teenage girl?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, brilliant disguise!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Man! I thought it was a real girl. (walks away in disappointment)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Now for your mission. Slushy the Clown statues have disappeared all over the Tri-State Area. Without that clown, there's just nothing fun about lunch anymore.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl and I have lunch at Mr. Slushy Burger every day.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We really miss that clown. (sniffles) So, ahem, drop whatever you're doing and find out what happened to those statues by lunchtime.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace? Hey, Candace! Awesome scooter! Hey, wanna come to Slushy Burger with my mom and me?

Name: Perry/Candace
Dialog: (smiles awkwardly and tips his/her fedora; The light turns green and he/she hurriedly speeds off.)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Was that a yes or a no?

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: I don't know, but I like the hat.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, it's a good look for her.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Come on, guys! Are you almost done? Jeremy's gonna be here soon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb's printing up the last one now. Looks great, Ferb.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (reading from the flyer) "Lost platypus. Looks like a girl"? Why did you use that picture? I don't want anyone to see me like that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the only picture we had. (To Isabella) Good job, Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Glad I could help!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Aaaah! Now everyone will see that horrible picture!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: OK, Candace, just stay here while we post these around town. We'll find Perry in no time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Ejecting a voice box) Not anymore! (crash) A teenage girl? (Perry/Candace dons the fedora) Perry the teenage girl?! (He pulls out a controller from his lab coat, pushes the button, and Perry/Candace is trapped in a platypus sized cage) Sorry about the tight fit, but, you know, if I knew you were going to disguise yourself as a teenage girl, I would've set a bigger trap. I suppose you're wondering why I have all these clowns, right? Well, you see, I've had that Slushy Burger jingle stuck in my head for, like, a week.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I hate that song so much, I've stolen all the clowns, and I'm going to rip their tape boxes out. You know, like you do. And I'm going to replace it with my own evil jingle. I just have to finish writing it. I'm having a hard time finding a good rhyme for "evil," though, you know. Believe me, I've tried. Keevil, deevil, feevil... You know, none of these are words.

Name: Police Officer
Dialog: You guys lost a platypus?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep.

Name: Police Officer
Dialog: Officer 3323. Tell Charlie we have a 10-91-P. Yeah, it's a platypus. Looks like a girl. MIA. (To Phineas and Ferb) Don't worry, boys. After a nice lunch at Mr. Slushy Burger, the Tri-State area's finest will be on the job.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: By the way, our mom's also missing her earrings.

Name: Police Officer
Dialog: Which ones? The dangly topaz or the hoops?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The hoops.

Name: Police Officer
Dialog: Oh, that's a shame. We'll get right on it.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Mom, you won't believe what Phineas and Ferb did!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What did they do this time?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: All you have to do is look at me! (Doorbell rings) If that's Jeremy, tell him... I'm getting ready. I don't want him to see me like this. (doorbell rings again)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (looks up) OK, Candace, now what's so important? (Opens door) Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Mrs. Flynn. Is Candace here?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, she's still getting ready. You know girls. Have a seat. While you wait, I'll make you a snack. (sits on the couch, sees Candace/Perry underneath)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, Perry. Come up here. How's my favorite little platypus today?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Oh hee- hee- hee- hee I mean... (tries to imitate Perry's chatter)

Name: Crowd
Dialog: (reading the billboard) "Lost platypus. Looks like a girl." You know, that's insulting to the platypus. How are we supposed to tell if it's a girl?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why don't you watch some TV while you wait? Oh, hey. I've got some great baby movies of Candace. (baby cooing) Ohh! There she is in the bathtub. (bubbles gurgle) Oops! Little bubbles.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (walks off screen) Mom! Remember what we talked about? My fifth-grade graduation? (comes back to the couch)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Fifth-grade graduation? What is she talking about?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Ugh! (walks off screen again) Just turn off the home movies!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Meevil, steevil, cleavil.... heevil. As soon as I get this done, lunchtime will never again be fun. Oh, great! There's a rhyme! There's a rhyme, but sure, everything rhymes with "fun." (Perry/Candace tries to hit him with his tail, but only waves his/her behind in his face) Ha! You don't have a tail anymore. Now you are no match for me! But wait a minute. I-I-I can't hit a girl. (gets hit with Perry/Candace's shoulder bag) Oof! Did you have that purse when you came in? (Perry/Candace twirls the purse like it's a set of nunchucks) Well, I'm out of here. (attempts to speed away, leaving a smoke figure which dissipates, revealing Doofenshmirtz again) What just happened?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You're such a nice boy, Jeremy. I can see why Candace built a shrine of you in her room. (laughs) Oopsy! I probably shouldn’t have said that. Thanks for feeding Perry while I look for my earrings.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure, no problem. What's in this platypus food, anyway?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mostly worms and insect larvae. (Candace/Perry starts to barf then Linda puts her outside) Oh, Perry! Now I have to get the carpet cleaned again! Hey, maybe I lost my earrings when I was folding Candace's laundry. Why don't you help me look while you wait, Jeremy?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (locked out of the house in the backyard. She knocks on the door, and starts sweating out of nervousness) Am I sweating milk?! Being a platypus is so gross!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait! I can't- I can't fight you when you're dressed as a girl. It's so...como se dice... awkward. Look! Shoes on sale! (Perry/Candace looks where Doofenshmirtz points. He tries to run for it during his/her momentary distraction, but he/she takes out an MP3 player out of the purse and throws it at him, rendering him trapped in the now comically long wire.) Curse you, Perry the teenager!

Name: Male teen
Dialog: Hey! The girl missing her platypus found Slushy the Clown!

Name: Kids
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: This is horrible! Mom is inside, ruining my love life!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Great. Change me back now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So this is how you went through the first time, right? You were holding Perry?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (Holding Perry/Candace, arms shaking) Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes. Hurry! Oh! He's a lot heavier now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder if it worked.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (angrily) You guys are so busted, I'm telling Mom! (she leaves)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You might consider bathing first.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I gotta get out of this! (hops around in vain trying to escape from the MP3 wire and accidentally hits a button on the panel of an -Inator with plants all over it. It fires) Gah! Oh, my old Shrinkinator. (sighs) I suppose I should've unplugged it before I turned it into a planter.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (comes into the garage with an gleeful look on her face) Come on, Mom, hurry up! (at Phineas and Ferb) You're busted! (The ray from the Shrinkinator hits the teleporter.; With her eyes closed) See?! see?! It's right there!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (enters, wearing the blue dressed as mentioned earlier; smiles) Oh, my goodness. (Candace gets a shocked expression on her face; reveals the teleports have been shrunken by the Shrinkinator.) Did you make these?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (confused) Uh... yeah.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (gasps and holds them up to her ears) These are so much nicer than the ones I lost!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Thanks, boys. (Candace jaw drops; at her, closing her mouth) Close your mouth, honey. You'll catch flies. (Candace scowls as Linda walks out.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: [still trapped by Perry/Candace] Great. Now I have this song stuck in my head.
